measured_basis.published_weak: fixed witness 1316..1351, no native edge; release qualifies 1353
measured_basis.low_offset: fixed witness 1322..1355, no native edge; release qualifies 1357
measured_basis.high_offset_counterexample: fixed witness 1313..1350 contains native edge 1323; optional onset at 1315 must not count as a new contact
measured_basis.strong_a_b: native edge occurs inside the active witness or earlier in the same uninterrupted initial pickup lifecycle

unchanged_signal.source: causal NormalForce encoder/JTS estimate opposed to commanded TCP velocity
unchanged_signal.note: identical thresholds to both earlier R30 studies; no force fitting or fixed delay

mechanism.owner: first uninterrupted open-gripper commanded pickup lifecycle only
mechanism.pending: onset opens a pending physical pulse but emits nothing
mechanism.consume: any native/base alarm during the pending pulse or earlier in the same pickup lifecycle consumes the optional source
mechanism.release: three consecutive samples at or below the existing 2.5 N unloading boundary close the physical pulse
mechanism.report: at physical release only, emit once iff pickup remains live and no native owner was observed
mechanism.retire: grip closure, command stop after pickup starts, sustained measured reversal, invalid kinematics, or first report permanently retires the optional source
mechanism.native: base output is returned unchanged and is never delayed, masked, or shortened

known_gates.weak: published weak and prior low-offset miss get exactly one rescue after release, within the registered tool tail and without prealarm
known_gates.native_counterexample: prior high-offset native edge remains 1323 within 2 ms and gets no optional edge
known_gates.strong: A/B/C and late signed rows exactly retain native edges and active duration within +5
known_gates.negative: zero-offset and normal twins stay silent
known_gates.signed: later oblique and negative-Z native inputs remain present with no delay over +5

prelocked_fresh_matrix_if_known_passes.rule: execute once after source freeze and known admission; do not alter source from outcomes

falsifier: reject on any existing native onset advance/loss, optional notice before physical release, negative false edge, or independent ownership ambiguity; no fourth mechanism
